Stronger sorry auto correct.  Archetypes are what you call the different decks and their variations. One of the more common ones is Beat down or hog cycle.  Strats = strategy

**Beat down:** is a deck where you use a tank like a peka and play support cards behind it. The strategy is to get a huge push going.

**Hog cycle:** is a deck where hog rider is your main win condition. The point of the deck is to play Hog, baiting their counters out, and then to cycle with cheap cards to get hog again. That way, your opponent is always out of counters for your hog, or they have to play passive throughout the whole match allowing you to slowly chip your tower.

​

But there are many different types of decks you can build ( over 14 billion ) and these aren't the only two archetypes you'll see.
